title: Vendor credit limits stay editable on COD and Credit Hold
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure vendor A (made for this test) holds COD with a credit limit of $2,000.00.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Open Edit Vendor for vendor A.
  2. Replace the limit with 2500.
  3. Choose "Credit Hold" in Credit Terms.
  4. Click Save & Close.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Credit Limit reads $2,000.00 and is editable (no lock, no $0.00).

Step 2:

  • The limit reads 2500.

Step 3:

  • The limit still reads 2500 and stays editable.

Step 4:

  • The vendor saves on Credit Hold with a $2,500.00 limit, exactly as before the release.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11675 (Story 6, Vendors)

  • S6-R4: “Vendor credit limits behave exactly as today on every term, COD and Credit Hold included: no lock, no $0 rule.”
  • Out of Scope: “Vendor credit limits. Vendor credit limits behave exactly as today on every term, including COD and Credit Hold. A vendor's limit plays no part in invoicing customers or in the Over Credit warning, so the customer $0 rule has no problem to solve there (owning PM, 2026-10-20).”
